title: Spacecraft recovered from Aztec (Kingman)
summary: Ross Coulthart tells of Spacecraft recovered from Aztec (Kingman), about 1948 / 1953 at New Mexico (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Oh, by the way, there's a there's a spacecraft recovered from Aztec.

plain: A journalist named Ross Coulthart, speaking with podcast host Jesse Michels, relays a remark linked to David Grusch, a former intelligence officer turned whistleblower, that a spacecraft was recovered from Aztec, New Mexico. The story ties this to supposed crash recoveries between 1948 and 1953, including one at Kingman, Arizona, which, if true, would mean the US government has held non-human craft for decades.
